figures.title: Figure 1
figures.llm_description: Fig. 1. Schematic diagram of sensing head and measure-ment system, n1: refractive index of dry air, ∆n: refractive index transition due to thermal lens ef-fect when pumping beam is absorbed by vapor in atmosphere, f0: focal length, dc: diameter of fiber’s core.

figures.title: Figure 2
figures.llm_description: Fig. 2. Relative humidity in atmosphere dependence of detected signal as the function of temperature, modulation frequency fm of pumping beam: 10 Hz, power of pumping beam: 100 mW, Spheri-cal Radius of Spherical lensed fibers used: 10 µm.

figures.title: Figure 3
figures.llm_description: Fig. 3. Temperature of air dependence of 1) estimated ab-solute humidity at 1013 hPa, 18 ◦C (shown as two lines) and 2) normalized detected signals (shown as plots), D.A.: Dry Air.
